notes: Lead captured from inbound signup. SMB ecommerce chat + search use. Primary pain: sporadic latency spikes impacting checkout assistant - customers report 'sometimes the bot takes too long' during peak traffic. Current setup: default region (auto), timeout defaults (120s), no streaming enabled. Dev notes: sample logs show majority of time spent on network + first-token generation in some regions. SE recommended: try explicit region pin (us-west1) for their US customer base, enable streaming to surface first-token faster, set client timeout to 30-60s for UI flows, trim system prompt and enforce 512 token user prompt cap for chat to reduce tail latencies. Also suggested short-term cache on static completions (pricing answers) and client-side optimistic UI for expected answers. Customer is cost-sensitive; wants to avoid overprovisioning. They asked: "Can we just pin to closest region? Is there an easy toggle?" AE walked them through Console region selector; they prefer a step-by-step runbook.
